## DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [CharacterCursor](CharacterCursor.md) | record struct | Identifies the position of a character within the original text being drawn. |
| [ICharacterAttributes](ICharacterAttributes.md) | interface | Supplies the drawing attributes for each character of a string. |
| [SpriteBatchTextExtensions](SpriteBatchTextExtensions.md) | class | Draws text in a sprite batch, the way [`SpriteBatch.Draw`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#draw) draws a sprite. |
| [SpriteFont](SpriteFont.md) | class | A font drawn with [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md) from glyphs packed into one or more atlas pages, built from a TTF/OTF font (and optional fallback fonts) by the toolkit SpriteFontContent pipeline. |
| [SpriteFontLoader](SpriteFontLoader.md) | class | Loads [`SpriteFont`](SpriteFont.md) content (`.spritefont` files built by the toolkit SpriteFontContent pipeline) together with all of its atlas pages. |

| [TextCorners](TextCorners.md) | enum | How the corners of an underlay ([`TextUnderlay`](TextUnderlay.md)) are drawn. |
| [TextEffects](TextEffects.md) | record | The visual effects of a piece of text: underlays under its face (outlines, shadows, glows, depths), and the face's own gradient, sheen, emboldening and softness. |
| [TextGradient](TextGradient.md) | record struct | Two colors a text's face is drawn in, one blending into the other down each line. |
| [TextLayers](TextLayers.md) | enum | The layers of text with [`TextEffects`](TextEffects.md) that a `DrawString` call draws. |
| [TextLayout](TextLayout.md) | class | Text wrapped to a width: lines broken at spaces, hyphens and line feeds, and between CJK characters with their punctuation rules, aligned, and cut off with an ellipsis past a number of lines. |
| [TextLayoutLine](TextLayoutLine.md) | record struct | A line of a [`TextLayout`](TextLayout.md): which part of the text it shows, and how wide that is. |
| [TextSheen](TextSheen.md) | record struct | A band of light across a text's face, upright or leaning: brightest along its middle, fading to nothing at its edges. |
| [TextUnderlay](TextUnderlay.md) | record struct | A copy of text's glyphs drawn under its face: grown by a width, moved, softened and painted. |

## DotGame.Toolkit.Particles

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer](AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer.md) | record | Draws each particle as a frame of a [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md), chosen from its age, so frames, holds and playback are authored like any sprite animation. |
| [CompositeParticleRenderer](CompositeParticleRenderer.md) | record | Draws the same particles with each of several renderers in turn, for example a soft glow under a crisp core. |
| [EmitShape](EmitShape.md) | record struct | Where around an emitter its particles start. |
| [FloatRange](FloatRange.md) | record struct | A range of values, sampled uniformly at random; a single value converts to a range of one value. |
| [IParticleBehavior](IParticleBehavior.md) | interface | Custom code for a particle effect, for what its built-in values don't cover. |
| [Particle](Particle.md) | struct | A particle's simulation state, as a custom [`IParticleBehavior`](IParticleBehavior.md) sees and adjusts it. |
| [ParticleAnimationTiming](ParticleAnimationTiming.md) | enum | How an [`AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer`](AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer.md) times its animation. |
| [ParticleBlend](ParticleBlend.md) | enum | How particles combine with what's behind them. |
| [ParticleBurst](ParticleBurst.md) | record struct | A burst of particles at a time in an emitter's run. |
| [ParticleColor](ParticleColor.md) | record struct | The colors particles are given when they start (or end), sampled per particle. |
| [ParticleCurve](ParticleCurve.md) | class | A value that changes over a particle's life (or an emitter's duration), from time 0 to 1, as keys joined by easing curves. |
| [ParticleCurveKey](ParticleCurveKey.md) | record struct | A point on a [`ParticleCurve`](ParticleCurve.md): its value at a time from 0 to 1, reached from the previous key along `Ease` (linearly when null). |
| [ParticleDrawState](ParticleDrawState.md) | struct | A particle as it's drawn: everything the system works out for it (where it is, how big, which way, what color, how old), for a [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md) to turn into pixels. |
| [ParticleEffect](ParticleEffect.md) | record | What a particle effect looks like and how it behaves: how particles are drawn, how they're emitted, how they start, how they move, and how they change over their lives. |
| [ParticleEmitter](ParticleEmitter.md) | struct | A running emission point in a [`ParticleSystem`](ParticleSystem.md), from [`ParticleSystem.CreateEmitter`](ParticleSystem.md#createemitter): it emits its system's effects continuously until it's stopped or their durations end. |
| [ParticleFlip](ParticleFlip.md) | record struct | A flutter, as of a flat piece of paper turning over: each particle's width narrows and widens. |
| [ParticleOverflow](ParticleOverflow.md) | enum | What happens to a new particle when an effect already has its [`ParticleEffect.Capacity`](ParticleEffect.md#capacity) of particles. |
| [ParticleOverrides](ParticleOverrides.md) | record struct | Changes to an effect's values for one burst, such as a direction or color that depends on where it's used. |
| [ParticleRenderer](ParticleRenderer.md) | record | Draws an effect's particles from their final state. |
| [ParticleSpawn](ParticleSpawn.md) | record struct | One particle placed exactly, for patterns the effect's random values don't describe. |
| [ParticleSway](ParticleSway.md) | record struct | A sideways sway, as of paper or leaves falling: each particle is offset along X by a sine wave, starting from no offset. |
| [ParticleSystem](ParticleSystem.md) | class | Runs particle effects: emits, moves, and draws their particles. |
| [SpriteParticleRenderer](SpriteParticleRenderer.md) | record | Draws each particle as a texture, a whole texture or an atlas region, through the toolkit's trim-aware [`SpriteBatchExtensions.Draw`](SpriteBatchExtensions.md#draw). |
| [StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer](StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer.md) | record | Draws each particle as a texture pointed along its velocity and lengthened in proportion to its speed, for sparks, rain, and speed lines. |
